fact: Askani Gambia refers to the 14,334 multiple registrations in the IEC 2026 supplementary exercise as having occurred in a biometric registration system, with the provisional register to be merged with the 2021 voter register.
The IEC said the provisional voters' list was displayed at 730 registration centres from 7 to 16 July 2026 for corrections, appeals and objections, later extended to 27 July.
IEC chairperson Joseph Colley said the provisional voter register would be published at all registration centres from 7 July 2026 for voters to verify their details.

The Gambia's IEC opened a supplementary voter registration on 8 April 2026, run by 100 teams at 730 centres with the Commission's voter registration software and equipment, adding to the 2021 Voter Register.
The IEC published the full provisional voters' list under s.22(5) of the Elections Act 2025 and extended the appeals and objections period to 27 July 2026.
The IEC said it holds custody of the voter database for the 2026 supplementary registration, run with equipment and cyber support from contractor ESI.
